Gloom Keep - or e1m5 - is the fifth level of the Dimension of the Doomed. It is a medium-sized castle surrounded by a moat. The Keep features various architecture, including rooms, corridors, stained glass windows and Elevators, as well as a gauntlet-like area with numerous traps such as Nail Traps, Falling Spikes, and the exclusive Sliding Spikes.
* '''Secrets:''' 5
